description: Generated deepcopy functions for Kubernetes metrics API v1alpha1, including deep copy methods for ContainerMetrics, NodeMetrics, PodMetrics, and their list types, used for object copying and serialization.

classes.name: ContainerMetrics
classes.description: Represents metrics for a container, including resource usage.

classes.name: NodeMetrics
classes.description: Represents metrics for a node, including metadata, timestamp, window, and usage.

classes.name: PodMetrics
classes.description: Represents metrics for a pod, including metadata, timestamp, window, and container metrics.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies receiver object into out parameter.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the receiver object.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object.
